the new leader of Blue Cosmos.

dd81362dc3:

Quite the results.

The winners are what's right!
2c0b9d89a3:

...That's all there is to it.
da56e328b8:
You've provided us with excellent samples
of biological CPUs.
They'll be a great help in future development.
4ddffa4719:
With these results, the military and the members of
LOGOS will recognize the importance of the next
Boosted Men. I'm grateful to you.
